record.question: Which one of the following is inaccurate about the mode of deposit of earnest money?
options: The earnest money is to be deposited as may be prescribed in the NIT.
In case of postponement of tender due to bank holiday on the last date of receipt of tender, the validity of already prepared earnest money as provided originally will not be acceptable.
The bank guarantee submitted as a part of earnest money shall be valid for a period of 90 days from the date of submission of tender where only financial bids are invited.
The bank guarantee submitted as a part of earnest money shall be valid for a period of 180 days from the date of submission of tender where two or three bid system is followed.
record.explanation: Postponement due to bank holiday does not invalidate prepared earnest money.
